description:
This node anchors Arthur Chapin as a named position within the 2015 New Human cohort, based solely on the textual manifestation in the compiled double issue. The lead work is *Archaic Torso in Nevada*, and the section also contains “The Bone Chapel.”

The anchor notes that the lead title relocates the Rilkean archaic torso into the American desert. That relation is an interpretive clue and discovery aid, not proof of direct derivation beyond the title’s visible allusion. The position is otherwise governed by the same civil-name fold as the cohort: no link to an external person is asserted or denied.

The record supplies membership, provenance, venue permission, and provisional routing without reducing the position into a biography. Its distinctive contribution is the pairing of classical-European art-poem inheritance with Nevada and the bone-chapel motif inside the 2015 issue.

wiki_article:
**Arthur Chapin — Provenance Anchor** records a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort.

The position’s lead manifestation is *Archaic Torso in Nevada*, and its section also includes “The Bone Chapel.” The archive identifies the position by these texts and its appearance in the compiled issue.

No civil-name relation is disclosed or inferred. The node is a provenance route into the issue rather than a biographical record.
